description: This Java class 'ReportsRepository' is a JDBC-based data access object responsible for retrieving various report data related to billing, revenue, and customer summaries within a backend API project. It contains SQL queries, row mappers, and methods for fetching report data from the database.

classes.name: ReportsRepository
classes.description: A repository class for executing SQL report queries and mapping the results to DTOs, utilizing Spring's JdbcTemplate for database interaction.

methods.name: customerBillLineItems
methods.description: Fetches billing line items for a specific customer by customer ID, returning a list of CustomerBillLineItemDto objects.

methods.name: monthlySummary
methods.description: Generates a monthly summary report for all customers within a specified year and month, returning a list of MonthlyCustomerSummaryRowDto objects.

methods.name: revenueByCustomer
methods.description: Calculates and returns revenue data aggregated by customer, returning a list of RevenueByCustomerRowDto objects.

methods.name: revenueByCategory
methods.description: Calculates and returns revenue data aggregated by billing category, returning a list of RevenueByCategoryRowDto objects.

methods.name: totalRevenue
methods.description: Computes and returns the total revenue across all billing hours and categories as a BigDecimal.
